policy.fullPassRule: A semantic injector can run only when the current capture contains a >=3.0 ms/s measured callback, the library rule matches, and the current live mod source graph proves its anchors.
policy.note: The production semantic base is intentionally compact and callback-specific. Runtime cost only earns review; automatic rules require a small, provable state model, exact known callback families, and no bespoke timing.

examplesNotForSemanticBase: DualSense Support (until its author handleUpdates lifecycle is fully proven)
admissionPolicy.note: Hot means review-worthy, not semantic-library-worthy. The base catalog is reserved for high-cost features with a provable inactive state and complete safe wake path.

behavior.note: Only skip queue workers when their queues are empty. Do not alter interaction/UI cadence or the author's 0.5 s police/subscription core.
Keep remote-control following and Cron frame-responsive. Refresh cached crosshair target at 5 Hz while UI/scanner features are dormant because hotkeys consume ent/entID; use 30 Hz while active.

identityHints: Auto Ammo Crafting (I need more bullets)

catalog.entryMeaning: Production AUTO behavior rules only. Every entry has an enabled source injector; reviewed/rejected candidates live in evidence ledgers instead.
catalog.note: Evidence sets record where a rule was learned. They do not install a collection or cause unrelated mods to be emitted.

reviewedExcluded.note: Measured and behavior-classified, but no production AUTO injector is authorized. Keep as evidence only until a compact safe rule exists.
Author handleUpdates gate exists, but current evidence does not prove a safe automatic inactive/wake lifecycle. Do not substitute a handcrafted 30 Hz output cadence.
Grounded IDLE still waits on realtime movement/input transitions; a 30 Hz idle lane is bespoke tuning, not a general dormant rule.
